newsitem.title: USA: Superior Natl plans audit of acquired Co..
newsitem.headline: Superior Natl plans audit of acquired Co..

text.p: Superior National Insurance Group Inc Friday said it is auditing three years of financial statements of a recently acquired company, but any earnings adjustments that may be made will not have a material effect on future operating results.
In a statement, Superior said the audit may cause it to recognize added goodwill that would be amortized over time.

"Additional goodwill would have a negative effect on net earnings and earnings per share of Superior, (but) Superior does not expect any negative impact to be material to its post-acquisition results of operations," it said.

Superior said Pac Rim Holding Corp, which was acquired in April, provided financial statements for 1994, 1995 and 1996 that may not be consistent with generally accepted accounting principles. Superior did not detail the possible discrepancies or estimate the effect on earnings. It has hired KPMG Peat Marwick LLP to re-audit the figures.
Superior said audit results will be disclosed in a filing with the Securities and Exchange commission "as soon as possible." It said the audit is not expected to be complete before mid-August.

"We are disappointed that Pac Rim's financial statements will have to be re-audited, but the overall impact of the acquisition was favorable and future prospects for the combined companies remain excellent," said Chris Seaman, chief financial officer.
